baseline.pin_scope: six pre-existing sources match saved v16 public source; one new helper

findings.title: A natural save-status question becomes a voice-enrollment sample
findings.reproduction: Real paired BoardBusinessRuntime + BoardDialogueJobs + temporary synthetic SQLite + fake encoder. Explicit voice enrollment completes its full playback ACK, then a normal next request asks the public fixture question: 你有没有保存我的声纹？
findings.impact: The whitelist does not recognize this management question. The active enrollment route consumes it as a sample; no identity grant or committed enrollment was demonstrated by this question alone.
findings.required_fix: Recognize unambiguous speaker save-status/active-status management questions before enrollment sampling in both the paired route and LocalIdentityReplies. Keep explicit action/confirmation validation and raw input recording unchanged. Do not classify all arbitrary enrollment sentences as management questions.

findings.title: An accepted exact request retry bypasses receipt TTL and gallery revision validation
findings.reproduction: Actual BoardSpeakerBusiness public turn() API with synthetic stores and fake encoder: explicitly enroll three samples and confirm; query once; expire the 60-second receipt or change speaker-store revision; retry identical current actor/generation/full metadata/request ID before the same original 120-second deadline. A new request ID is the control.
findings.impact: The supported same-metadata retry returns the cached positive while a fresh request returns unknown. Normal new-request next turns were not shown to bypass TTL. This is stale status evidence, not an identity authorization bypass.
findings.required_fix: Re-evaluate current actor, receipt TTL, gallery revision, and target existence for read-only status retries before returning cached status. Preserve idempotency for write/action retries: never rerun enrollment or delete merely to refresh the query.

additional_source_confirmed_gap.evidence_kind: source review and author/parent independent source confirmation; no extra race test in this review
additional_source_confirmed_gap.issue: After a real enrollment transaction commits, SpeakerDevice can create a temporary receipt before the outer job current check fails. The original _cancel_actor clears active sessions but not this new receipt.
additional_source_confirmed_gap.required_boundary: Invalidate temporary status evidence for the cancelled owner and reply unknown on later status queries as required by the new policy. Do not delete the actually committed identity/template, roll back a completed transaction, or claim that saved data was not saved.

positive_checks: The existing complete paired runtime/Store/ACK scenario passes: recognized status queries before/during/after commit are read-only; a fresh request after TTL returns unknown.

Jobs session_id survives ordinary generation changes and full ACK. Conversation/profile selection controls session identity; using (boot,session) is appropriate and must not be narrowed to one generation.
Receipt revision is the identity/template store metadata revision, not timeline event count or general SQLite activity. Unrelated visual events need not invalidate a receipt.
Receipt construction follows original store.enroll return, revision +1 and identity existence checks. Original IdentityStore transaction commits before enroll returns.
Confirmed full-path question reproduction grants zero profile permissions. No threshold, model, device, PCM, playback ACK, memory retention, or renderer change was made by this review.

new_counterexamples.interpretation: Three intended regression assertions fail, confirming two independent defects (TTL/revision are parameterized variants).

tests.initial_fixture_error: edges.xml is retained but not defect evidence: the first cache fixtures had a boot-ID mismatch; edges_final.xml uses matching boot IDs and is the reviewed result.
tests.suite_scope: Only one existing complete-flow test and three small synthetic counterexamples; the author 265-case suite was not rerun.

v3_acceptance_requirements: Re-run the natural status-question full paired/Store/ACK scenario and require no added enrollment vector/hash and no grant.
Same-current exact query replay must become unknown after TTL or gallery revision changes; original live deadline and same metadata must remain accepted by the outer service.
Successful write replay must stay idempotent; failed or pre-commit-cancelled writes must not create a success receipt.
Post-commit cancellation may invalidate temporary receipt only; durable identity/template facts must remain consistent with the real transaction.
A valid commit plus full ACK followed by a new generation in the same real session must still produce usable recent status. New boot/session or invalidated gallery evidence must yield unknown.
